originalTitle: The Polygamist's creator says women see themselves reflected in her Netflix hit
title: An Amazing African Writer and Her Popular Story!
content:
Hello, amazing friends! It's your kid-friendly news reporter, here to share a super exciting story from our wonderful continent, Africa! Get ready to meet a very special lady from Zimbabwe who is making big waves with her awesome stories.

Who is Sue Nyathi?

Imagine someone who loves to tell stories so much that she writes big, exciting books for everyone to read! That's exactly what Sue Nyathi does. She is a talented writer, and she comes from a beautiful country in Africa called Zimbabwe. Zimbabwe is famous for its amazing wildlife, like elephants and giraffes, and its friendly people. Sue is one of those friendly, super-smart people!

Her Big Story on TV!

Guess what? One of Sue's fantastic stories has become super, super popular! Lots of people are watching it on their TVs and tablets. It's called "The Polygamist" and it's on a special place called Netflix. Netflix is like a giant library of movies and shows that you can watch whenever you want! So, Sue's story is being watched by many, many families all over the world, not just in Africa! Isn't that cool? *Did you know?* Netflix is available in almost every country in the world! That means stories from Africa can reach friends far, far away!

Why Girls and Women Love Her Stories

Sue Nyathi says something very important about her stories. She says that girls and women who watch her story feel like they see themselves in it! What does that mean? It means when they watch the characters and their adventures, they think, "Hey, that character is a bit like me!" or "I know someone just like that!" It's like looking in a mirror and seeing your own feelings and experiences in a story. This makes the story very special because it helps people feel understood and represented. It shows that African women have important stories to tell, and everyone wants to hear them! *Simple Explanation:* When you "see yourself reflected" in a story, it means the story feels real to you, and you can understand the characters because they are like people you know, or even like yourself!

How She Started Her Writing Journey

Do you know how Sue Nyathi started her journey as a famous writer? It's a really inspiring tale! When she wrote her very first big book, she didn't have a big company to help her pay for it. She decided to use her own money, her own savings, to publish her book! This is called "self-funding." It means she believed in her story so much that she used her own hard-earned money to make sure her book could be printed and shared with the world. Imagine saving up your pocket money to make your dream come true! That's what Sue did for her first amazing book. She was determined, and that's a super power! *Did you know?* "Self-funding" means you use your own money for a project, like when you save up to buy something special you really want!

Being a Writer Can Be Tricky Sometimes

Writing wonderful stories sounds like so much fun, right? And it is! But sometimes, being a writer can also be a little bit tricky. Sue Nyathi asks a very good question: "Who can afford to write at all?" What she means is that it takes a lot of time and effort to write a book. Sometimes writers need to work other jobs to earn money, and it can be hard to find enough time to write their stories. Also, printing books and getting them into shops can cost money. So, it's not always easy for everyone to become a writer, even if they have amazing stories inside them. But Sue's story shows us that with hard work and belief, you can overcome these challenges!

Dreams Really Do Come Come True!

Look at Sue Nyathi's journey! She started by writing her own book, paying for it herself, and now her story is a big hit on Netflix! This is like a real-life fairy tale! It shows us that if you have a dream, and you work very, very hard, your dream can come true. It doesn't matter if it's about writing stories, becoming a doctor, or flying a plane. With courage, determination, and a big heart, you can achieve amazing things. Sue's success is a shining example for all of us, especially for young boys and girls in Africa, to chase their dreams. Never give up on what you love to do!

You Can Be a Storyteller Too!

Maybe you love telling stories to your friends, or drawing pictures that tell a story, or even making up songs with stories in them! Everyone can be a storyteller. You don't need to write a whole book right away. You can start by telling a story about your day, or an adventure you had, or something exciting you learned. Reading books is also a great way to become a better storyteller. The more you read, the more ideas you get, and the more words you learn. So, keep reading, keep imagining, and keep sharing your wonderful stories with everyone! Who knows, maybe one day your story will be on Netflix too! *Did you know?* Storytelling is an ancient African tradition! Our ancestors told stories around campfires to teach lessons and share history.

Proud of Our African Stories!

Sue Nyathi's success makes us all feel so proud! She is an African woman sharing African stories with the whole world. Her stories come from our continent, from our experiences, and they show the beauty and strength of African people. It's so important that our stories are heard and celebrated. When we see people like Sue Nyathi achieving great things, it makes us all stand a little taller and smile a little wider. Let's celebrate Sue and all the amazing storytellers across Africa! Hip hip hooray for African stories! Hip hip hooray for Sue Nyathi! We can't wait to see what wonderful stories she shares next!
summary: Sue Nyathi, a talented writer from Zimbabwe, achieved her dream by self-funding her first book, which later became a popular show on Netflix, showing how hard work can make dreams come true and celebrating African stories.
whyMatters: This story is important because it shows kids that if you work hard and believe in yourself, you can achieve your dreams, even if it's tricky sometimes, and it celebrates amazing storytellers from Africa.

originalTitle: World Cup winner Ferran Torres joins Paris Saint-Germain from Barcelona
title: Super Star Ferran Torres Joins a New Football Team!
content:
Hello, Wonderful Football Fans!

Hello, everyone! It's me, your kid-friendly news reporter, right here from Africa! I hope you are all having a super day. Today, we have some very exciting news about a famous football player. We know how much you all love football here in Africa! It’s such a fun game to watch and play. Let’s dive into the big news about a player who is making a big move! Get ready to cheer!

Meet Ferran Torres!

Our news today is about a really good football player named Ferran Torres. He is 26 years old, which means he is a grown-up player who has been playing for many years. Ferran Torres is known for being very fast and good at kicking the ball. He loves to score goals for his team. He is a very important player. Did you know? Football players are like heroes on the field! They work super hard and train every day to be the best they can be.

What is Football (Soccer)?

For our youngest friends, let's talk about football for a tiny bit! Football, or soccer as some call it, is a game played with a round ball. Two teams try to kick the ball into the other team's net. The team that scores the most goals wins! It is a game of skill, speed, and teamwork. It’s a game that makes everyone jump up and down with excitement when a goal is scored! It's played all over the world. Did you know? In many parts of the world, especially in countries like America, football is called soccer! But it’s the same exciting game.

His Old Team: FC Barcelona

Ferran Torres used to play for a very famous team called FC Barcelona. This team is from a beautiful country called Spain. Spain is in Europe. FC Barcelona is one of the biggest and best football clubs in the whole world! Many super-duper players have played for them. Their uniform is blue and red stripes. He played many games for Barcelona and helped them win matches. He was a very important player for them. Did you know? FC Barcelona's home stadium is called the Camp Nou, and it is one of the biggest football stadiums in the world! Imagine how many people can watch a game there!

His New Team: Paris Saint-Germain!

Now, for the big news! Ferran Torres is moving to a new team! He is joining a super strong team called Paris Saint-Germain. We often call them PSG for short. PSG is a football club from France. France is another country in Europe, and its capital city is Paris. Paris is famous for its Eiffel Tower! This team, PSG, is very special because they are the champions of their league! That means they were the best team in France last year. They have many famous players. They wear beautiful blue, red, and white uniforms. They are always trying to win big trophies and be the best in Europe. Did you know? Paris Saint-Germain is from Paris, a very famous and beautiful city in France! It's a place many people dream of visiting.

Why Do Players Change Teams?

You might be wondering, why would a player leave a famous team like Barcelona? Well, players move for different reasons. Sometimes, a player might want to try a new challenge. Maybe they want to play with new teammates or live in a new city. It’s like moving to a new school. Other times, a new team, like PSG, really wants a player to join them to make their team even stronger and help them win more games and big prizes! Did you know? When a player moves from one team to another, it's called a 'transfer'! It's like a special change for them and the teams.

What Does a Striker Do?

Ferran Torres is what we call a 'striker.' Do you know what a striker does? Their most important job is to score goals! They are the players who try their hardest to kick the ball into the net. They are usually at the front of the team, ready to attack. Strikers need to be very fast and have strong, accurate kicks. They are often the ones who make the crowd cheer the loudest! Did you know? Strikers practice very hard every day to kick the ball perfectly into the net, even from far away! It takes lots of skill and practice.

A Very Big Number!

When Ferran Torres moved to PSG, the new team paid a lot of money to his old team, Barcelona. They paid 50 million euros! That is a super, super big number! Imagine a mountain made of all your favorite toys or enough money to buy many, many houses! That's how much 50 million euros is. This money is called a 'transfer fee.' It helps the old team, Barcelona, and the new team, PSG, gets a fantastic player like Ferran Torres. Did you know? That money helps the old team buy new players or build better training fields for young kids who dream of being football stars!

Playing for a Long Time!

Ferran Torres has signed a 'five-year deal' with Paris Saint-Germain. This means he will play for his new team for a very long time – five whole years! That's a lot of games and a lot of training with his new teammates. It shows that PSG really, really wants him to be a part of their team for a long time. He will be wearing the blue, red, and white uniform of PSG in many, many matches. We will see him score lots of goals for them! Did you know? A long contract like a five-year deal means the team really trusts the player and wants them to stay and help them win many championships!

Lots of Excitement!

Everyone is very excited to see Ferran Torres play for Paris Saint-Germain. He is a super player, and he will help his new team a lot. Maybe with Ferran Torres, PSG will win even more games and more trophies! It makes watching football even more thrilling. We can't wait to see him run on the field, dribble the ball, and score amazing goals for his new club. It’s going to be a fun adventure for him and PSG! Did you know? We will soon see Ferran Torres wearing a new blue and red jersey, playing with his new teammates in the big stadium in Paris!

Keep Cheering for Football!

So, there you have it, football friends! A famous player, Ferran Torres, has a new home team. This is big news in the world of football. Keep playing football with your friends, keep cheering for your favourite teams, and keep dreaming big! Football is a wonderful game that brings everyone together. Goodbye for now, and see you next time with more exciting news from Africa and beyond! Stay happy and keep loving the beautiful game!
summary: Ferran Torres, a famous 26-year-old football player, has moved from the Spanish team FC Barcelona to the French champions Paris Saint-Germain (PSG) after PSG paid a very big amount of money and he signed a five-year deal.
whyMatters: This is important because Ferran Torres is a super good player, especially at scoring goals, and joining a strong team like PSG means he will help them win even more games and make football even more exciting to watch for all the fans!
